result.summary: Page layout is intact but found 1 major issue where Pizza filter appears active while non-pizza venues are shown, plus 2 minor inconsistencies in overlay icon styling and time-badge formatting.

issues.description: Category filter 'Pizza' is selected but displayed restaurants are non-pizza (Green Bowl Pok�e9, Smash Bros Burgers, Tokumaru Ramen Bar)
issues.suggestion: Ensure selecting a category filters the lists to matching cuisines, or clear the selected state if filters are not applied to these sections

issues.description: Wishlist heart icons have inconsistent treatment: ramen card shows white outline directly on image, pizza card shows white outline on dark circular scrim
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent scrim/background for overlay icons to ensure visibility and consistent style on all image backgrounds

issues.description: Delivery time badges use inconsistent formatting: '15-25 min' and '20-30 min' without spaces vs '20-30 min' with spaces around hyphen
issues.suggestion: Standardize time range format across all badges, e.g. consistently '15-25 min'
